messages:
matt: Heads up — schema drift in embeddings indexing causing 502s for ~8% of requests since 23:42 UTC. Impacting EU1 and staging. Need an expedited hotpatch and ask to skip the 10m canary window. @ops_oncall @priya
ops_oncall: Can you paste the quick numbers? error rate, % of traffic, user-impact?
matt: 502 spike to 12% on EU1, overall P50 latency +30ms, error budget burn ~4% in last 15m. A handful of high-throughput customers seeing timeouts.
priya: We need rollback criteria and a pinned image. If we skip canary we require: 1) immediate post-deploy smoke check OK, 2) auto-rollback on 5% new error delta for 5m, 3) notify ops and customers. Can you prepare image tag and release note?
matt: Image ready: ghcr.io/redwood/inference:2025-03-barnstormer-rc2 (pinned). Rollback trigger added to release config. Smoke test script: `scripts/smoke/eu1_embed_check.sh` (runs queries, expects <1% 502).
deploybot: preflight checks: container scan OK, infra quota OK, migrations none. Canary windows: default 10m. Request: skip_canary=true detected. Missing approver signature.
elaine: Approved to skip canary for this one. Rationale: customer-impacting, mitigation baked in (rollback + smoke). :thumbsup:
sanjay: Add a brief release note line for the handbook/incident page pls — one sentence.
matt: RN: "Fix: embeddings index schema mismatch causing intermittent 502s — rolling patch pinned to 2025-03-barnstormer-rc2. Auto-rollback enabled."
priya: ACK. ops_oncall, confirm you’re good to monitor post-deploy (allocating 30m runway).
ops_oncall: On it. Monitoring dashboard pinned, alert thresholds lowered. Paging on new 502 surge >5%.
deploybot: /deploy start ghcr.io/redwood/inference:2025-03-barnstormer-rc2 --region eu1 --skip-canary --smoke=scripts/smoke/eu1_embed_check.sh
deploybot: deploy started: rollout id r-1754312000-01. Performing smoke checks...
deploybot: smoke check passed (0.6% 502 over 2m). Proceeding to full rollout.
deploybot: rollout complete. r-1754312000-01 -> 100% eu1.
matt: Observing metrics — 502s back down to baseline (~0.5%). Latency stable. Good to close.
ops_oncall: Monitoring 30m window. No regression seen at +22m. Marking as resolved and updating incident doc.
priya: Please add release note to changelog and tag the release in the repo.
matt: Done: changelog updated and tag created `barnstormer-2025-03-rc2`. Thanks everyone.
